news_summary: India won both titles at the inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship in Ahmedabad on October 31, beating Sri Lanka 54-20 in the men's final and Uganda 35-15 in the women's final.
payoff: India became the first champions of the Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship in both the men's and women's competitions.
